evidence.title: Sevalla | Ship Production Apps Without Infrastructure

name: Sevalla
summary: Hosting platform to run applications, databases, object storage and static sites without managing infrastructure.
description: Deploy applications, managed databases, S3-compatible object storage and static sites on one platform, with resource-based pricing instead of per-seat plans. An MCP server lets AI agents deploy apps and databases, read logs and metrics, and debug production.
contains: application hosting from $5/month: git push and Docker image deploys, autoscaling
managed databases: 5 types, private networking, daily backups
static site hosting: free, 100GB bandwidth, 600 build minutes, 100 sites
25 data centers and 260+ PoP edge servers
MCP server for AI agents to deploy, inspect logs and metrics, and resolve issues
resource-based pricing with no per-seat fees and a free trial
